messages:
Alice Park: Starting a quick workshop on recurring incident patterns for this month. Goal: pick top 3 hypotheses and owners for fixes. Drop anything you saw in postmortems. I'll collate.

Ben Ramos: Quick summary from last month's postmortems — 4 incidents tied to cache invalidation, 3 to autoscale misconfig, 2 to model OOMs. Doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/recurring-jun

Chen Li: @Alice +1. Hypothesis A: cold-cache misses spike after deploys -> latency + throttling. Evidence: deploy-correlated spikes in /logs. Query I used: ```sql
SELECT deploy_id, count(*) FROM incidents WHERE tag='cache-miss' GROUP BY deploy_id ORDER BY 2 DESC;
```

Diego M.: Hypothesis B: batch scheduler starves small latency-sensitive requests under high throughput. Repro: load test in staging showed 2x tail latency when batching window > 20ms.

Emma K: Hypothesis C: autoscaler cooldowns too aggressive -> delayed scale-up for bursty traffic. Seen in 2 postmortems. Suggest reducing cooldown to 30s for critical pools.

incident-bot: digest: Created trend-summary card for June -> https://redwood.incidents/cards/1876000

Alice Park: OK. Let's pick top 3 fixes and owners. Proposed owners: Chen -> cache invalidation reliability; Diego -> batch scheduler improvements; Emma -> autoscale tuning. Targets: prototype by 2026-04-10, rollout canary by 2026-04-20. Thoughts?

Ben Ramos: Agree. Also add an instrumentation action: capture prefix cache hit rate per model + per-deploy. Owner: Ben. ETA: 2026-04-05.

Chen Li: I'll start a small PR to add per-deploy cache metrics and a test harness. ETA: 2026-04-08. Blocking: need permission to add a new prometheus metric; @SRE_Team can you grant?

SRE_Team: :thumbsup: Granting temporary write for a week. Logging the request.

Diego M.: For batching, I'll try adaptive windowing: debounce by request latency percentile instead of fixed ms. PoC in staging by 2026-04-07. Need a way to replay request traces - @Emma K can you share the anonymized trace bucket?

Emma K: Sharing trace bucket link in #eng-runtime and copying here: s3://redwood-prod-traces/anonymized/2026-03. Anyone with access please use staging creds.

Alice Park: Nice. Also let's formalize acceptance criteria. Proposed: 1) 30% reduction in incidents attributed to each cause over 90-day rolling window OR 2) no regression in end-to-end latency for critical paths. Add to each action item.

Ben Ramos: I'll own the measurement dashboard and weekly report. Will publish first snapshot 2026-04-14.

Chen Li: One more item: recurring incident taxonomy. We should tag all postmortems with a standardized cause tag (cache|batching|autoscale|model-oom|other). Owner: Alice. ETA: 2026-04-03.

Alice Park: Assigned. I'll update the postmortem template.

Diego M.: Can we also run a quick root-cause clustering job across last 180 days? I can run k-means on vectorized summaries. ETA: 2026-04-06. Will post results here.

Emma K: If clustering shows 'signal-to-noise' issues (lots of false positives), we should tighten alerting thresholds. Add as contingency action for owners.

Ben Ramos: Noted. Quick ask: please add any previous incidents you think belong in the same cluster with their ts.

Alice Park: Thanks all. I'll summarize action items and owners in a follow-up message tomorrow and create a recurring triage slot for progress checks. :calendar:
